original_datasets.notes: Original R scripts expected a local working directory; Python rewrites read from /app/data. Dataset appears to already reflect Illinois plumbing firms and total complaints per Task2 instruction.

tasks.task_instruction: Conduct the analysis without additional restriction.

analysis_path.path_description: Import final_data.dta; examine complaints distribution; create complaints_binary; test association with chi-square; fit Poisson and Negative Binomial GLMs; compare fit; optionally fit zero-inflated models; add controls in NB; replicate t-test by first_A.
preprocessing_steps: Compute 2x2 crosstab of first_A by complaints_binary and run chi-square test.
Fit Negative Binomial GLM: complaints_2008 ~ first_A.
Optionally fit zero-inflated Poisson and zero-inflated Negative Binomial.
Fit Negative Binomial with controls: complaints_2008 ~ first_A + multiple_names + on_google + ad_spend_k + firm_age + chicago + emp_size.
Run Welch t-test of complaints_2008 by first_A.

key_choices.inference_rule: z-statistic and p-value for first_A in GLMs; chi-square p-value for 2x2 test; Welch t-test p-value.
